title: Literal AI-tool self-declaration in source code
author: WinstonRedGuard -- sigma plugin ai-fingerprint observed rules
description:
Detects literal AI-tool self-declaration text embedded in a file's comments or docstrings -- commit-trailer-style phrases ('Co-Authored-By: Claude', 'Generated with Claude Code') or plain self-declarations ('Generated by ChatGPT') pasted along with generated code, or quoted as data by tooling that detects/strips such trailers. Per-hit confidence is high without requiring co-occurrence: a literal self-declaration is near-zero-FP by construction.

Aggregated from 1 fingerprint hit(s) across 1 file(s). Sample paths: apps/foo/bar.py.
